config.segmentBasis: A single segment; revenue is split into product (switches, routers, software licenses) and service (maintenance, support). The company also describes customer types (cloud and AI titans, enterprise, providers) but doesn't report them quarterly
config.fiscalNote: Fiscal year matches the calendar year. From Q1 2026, non-GAAP EPS no longer includes tax benefits on stock awards; prior periods are restated
kpis: Deferred revenue (contract amounts collected in advance)
modules: Where it sits in the AI loop

peer.n: networking peers (average of Cisco and Ciena)

fcfx.t: Free cash flow (operating cash flow minus capex)
